test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

This is the __old__ tree in the colony.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. oldest .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence refers to a comparison among all the trees in the colony, implying the oldest one.
 
• The word **"oldest"** is the superlative form of the adjective **"old"**, and it is used to compare more than two items or entities.
 
• Other options such as **"older"** are used for comparative purposes between two entities, and **"most old"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The word **"elder"** is typically used to refer to people, not objects like trees, and hence is not appropriate in this context.

Correct sentence: *This is the **oldest** tree in the colony*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Adjectives:**
 
 
• Used to compare two entities.
 
• **Example:** This tree is **older** than the one in the garden.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Adjectives:**
 
 
• Used to compare more than two entities to identify the one with the highest degree of the quality.
 
• **Example:** This is the **oldest** tree in the colony.
